Out Loud bundles these unmodified third-party files for its natural voices.

vendor/kokoro.web.js
  kokoro-js 1.2.1 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/kokoro-js), file dist/kokoro.web.js
  Licence: Apache-2.0. Copyright Xenova / Hugging Face.
  This single file is the library's own published browser build. It includes:
    - @huggingface/transformers 3.8.1 (Apache-2.0)
    - onnxruntime-web 1.22.0-dev.20250409-89f8206ba4 JavaScript (MIT, Microsoft)
    - phonemizer 1.2.1 (Apache-2.0), which contains a WebAssembly build of
      eSpeak NG (GPL-3.0-or-later)

vendor/ort/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.mjs and .wasm
  onnxruntime-web 1.22.0-dev.20250409-89f8206ba4 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/onnxruntime-web), files dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.*
  Licence: MIT. Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.

Voice model (downloaded once at first use, not bundled)
  onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX on Hugging Face, from hexgrad/Kokoro-82M.
  Licence: Apache-2.0.

Full licence texts: Apache-2.0 https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0 ;
